name: SPEEDSHOT
description:
About This Game

The core gameplay loop is simple: destroy all targets while trying to reach the end as fast as possible.

Levels require you to move with speed, efficiency, and control while hitting all targets. Chain together abilities, ramps, and other environmental boosts while utilizing slow motion to break records in this exhilarating yet accessible speedrunning game. Delve deeper into the "Layers" of the simulation and try to unlock Elite and Legendary medals.

FEATURES

  • 100+ lightning-fast levels

  • Unique abilities built to encourage speed, flow, and the discovery of unconventional movement tech

  • Speed Ramps with surfing mechanics inspired by classic Source™ Engine surfing, designed to be much more accessible

  • 3 Star, Elite, and secret Legendary medals to obtain on each level

  • Global Leaderboards for competitive players

  • Easy to learn, hard to master

Standard, Hardcore, Movement Mode, And Expedition Mode available at launch, giving plenty of variety to the way you play the levels. Hardcore encourages no slow-motion as the timer no longer slows when you use it. Movement Mode no longer requires you to hit enemy targets to finish. Expedition Mode is every level sequentially on one timer. All modes have separate leaderboards.
short_desc: SPEEDSHOT is a fast-paced FPS built for speedrunning. Master the fluid surfing and parkour, chain your unique abilities together, manipulate time and destroy the anomalies to break out of the simulation.
